title: Electronic Flight Bag Overheats and Blanks on Long Ground Waits — Request for Mount and Power Change

ata.title: Flight Deck Information — Electronic Flight Bag Unit

abstract: Pyrenean Air reports that the captain-side electronic flight bag shuts down on hot-weather turnarounds and asks for a change to the mount and its power feed so the crew are not calculating performance on a spare tablet.

sections.request: On a hot afternoon turnaround in Seville the left hand flight bag goes dark. The crew get a warning about temperature and then the screen blanks, and it will not come back until the air conditioning has been running for twenty minutes or so. It is always the left one, never the right, and our crews have worked out that if they swing the arm away from the windscreen it lasts longer, which tells you it is the sun on the glass rather than the unit itself. The practical effect is that the captain does the take-off performance on a hand-held tablet balanced on the pedestal, which our flight operations people are not happy about, and on two occasions the crew have delayed the departure until the unit came back. We would like the mounting moved out of the direct sun or the unit given a way of surviving it.
sections.background: Nineteen reports in one summer season, all from our southern bases and all between May and September. It is consistently the left hand installation. Our line maintenance have swapped the unit twice on one aircraft and the behaviour followed the aircraft, not the box. The right hand installation sits further from the windscreen and has never done it. We have also noticed that the unit stays powered when the aircraft goes on ground power, so it is sitting in the sun with the screen on for the whole turnaround.
sections.expected_outcome: An installation that keeps working through a two hour turnaround in forty degrees, either by moving the mount away from the windscreen or by letting the unit shed load and dim itself instead of shutting down. Whatever is done must not need the crew to learn a new procedure.

type_data.business_justification: Nineteen shutdowns in a single summer season, two departure delays and a flight operations position that performance must not be calculated on uncontrolled equipment.
